name: MVTec 3D-AD: MVTec 3D Anomaly Detection Dataset
description: Comprehensive 3D industrial anomaly detection dataset consisting of 4,147 high-resolution 3D scans across 10 real-world categories (bagel, cable gland, carrot, cookie, dowel, foam, peach, potato, rope, and tire). Acquired using an industrial structured-light 3D sensor, each sample provides synchronized 3D point cloud coordinates (XYZ channels) and registered high-resolution RGB imagery for multi-modal 3D surface defect detection and localization.
